Name: Craisins and Sultanas
Author: MissSweetBean
Description:
In keeping with the theme of the vanilla raisins, they're slightly less profitable than if they just used the standard dehydrator formula.
I haven't tested, but I doubt they work in Junimo Huts the same way raisins do, as I think that would require more than a content pack.

Config Options:
[list]
[*]Whether the new items are included in the shipping collection, and thus required for perfection (defaults to false)[/*]
[*]Whether Cornucopia - More Crops white grapes make sultanas (defaults to true)[/*]
[/list]
Translations are welcome; if you make an i18n file, please share it with me and I'll be happy to patch it in.


This is my very first mod posted, even if I've worked towards some others previously; this one was small and simple enough to bang out in less than a day though, so it has reached completion first.

Manifest.Name: Craisins and Sultanas
Manifest.Description: Adds craisins and sultanas as dried fruit replacements for cranberries and Cornucopia white grapes respectively.
Manifest.Author: MissSweetBean
